files.description: Quiz results (80 rows, one per student in seat order, no other columns): quiz_a and quiz_b (points 0-10, whole numbers, many equal values; about 9% and 6% of cells empty for absent students).

task_text: The pass marks are 6 points for quiz_a and 5 points for quiz_b; an empty cell means the student was absent from that quiz. For each quiz, give the share of the students who took it (non-empty cell) whose score is at or above the pass mark. `result` should be a Series indexed by quiz.
intended_computation: quiz_a: scores >= 6 divided by the 73 non-empty quiz_a cells; quiz_b: scores >= 5 divided by the 75 non-empty quiz_b cells.

acceptable_variants.notes: shares as 0-1 values to 6 significant digits.

predicted_direction.reason: The comparison with a nullable pass-mark Series gives missing values for absent students on 3.1, which mean() skips as the task asks; on 2.x they were False and counted in the denominator.

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 by pkg:TASKS_M2 for catalogue row N05; naive.py shows the invited idiom, reference.py is the version-robust reference.
